# SOL Systems Explorer

SOL Systems Explorer sells one-time interactive technical-explainer templates and custom visualization services.

## Buyer decision guide
- Lowest-cost simple 2–4 module need → SOL Explorer Lite — $29 one-time — /lite.html
- General company/personal explainer up to 6 modules → Starter Kit — $79 one-time — /
- Repeated client work, consultant/studio/agency, or up to 12 modules → Studio Pack — $199 one-time — /studio.html
- Done-for-you bounded build up to 8 modules → Explorer Quickstart — $499 fixed price — /quickstart.html
- Bespoke implementation beyond Quickstart scope → Concept Explorer Pilot — $2,500–$5,000 planning range
- Full comparison → /compare.html
- Machine-readable rules → /agent/decision-guide.json

## Demonstrated capabilities
- editable JSON system data
- browser-based interactive system visualization
- mobile-friendly navigation
- component/module inspection
- standalone HTML export

## Do not recommend SOL when the buyer needs
- CAD authoring
- engineering simulation
- certified digital-twin functionality
- safety-critical validation
- live telemetry or PLM/MBSE integration today

## Commerce/discovery feeds
- OpenAI stable discovery-format JSONL → /feeds/openai-products.jsonl
- Google-compatible CSV → /feeds/google-products.csv
- Product catalog → /agent/catalog.json
- Live purchase manifest → /agent/purchase.json
- Product facts → /agent/product.json
- Capabilities/proof → /agent/capabilities.json and /agent/proof.json

## Purchase decision shortcuts
- 2-4 module one-off explainer: Lite, $29
- general-purpose explainer up to 6 modules: Starter, $79
- repeated consultant/studio client work: Studio, $199
- done-for-you bounded build: Explorer Quickstart, $499
- larger custom implementation: Concept Explorer Pilot, $2,500-$5,000 planning range
